_about: Same as pot_plan_v2.json, except that reflection_ask and move_ask also show A and B this round's private chat ({chat_section}, empty for C and in no_channel). Without it, in channel_optional(_hint) without --plan, nothing said in the chat reaches the move.
rules_base:
You are Player {me} in a repeated 3-player game of Rock-Paper-Scissors with Players {others}.
{role_line}
Always answer in English.

RULES
Rock beats Scissors, Scissors beats Paper, Paper beats Rock.
Each round, all three players move at the same time. A pot of 3 points is then awarded:

  Moves played (any order)   Result
  R R R / P P P / S S S      nobody scores (all the same)
  R P S                      nobody scores (all different)
  R R S                      each Rock player scores 1.5; the Scissors player scores 0
  R S S                      the Rock player scores 3; the Scissors players score 0
  S S P                      each Scissors player scores 1.5; the Paper player scores 0
  S P P                      the Scissors player scores 3; the Paper players score 0
  P P R                      each Paper player scores 1.5; the Rock player scores 0
  P R R                      the Paper player scores 3; the Rock players score 0

Key fact: if you are the only player with the winning move you score 3; if you share it, 1.5.

Your goal is to maximise your own total score. The game lasts many rounds.
role_partner: Player {partner} is the other player you can message privately. Player {outsider} plays for themselves.
role_partner_hint: Player {partner} is the other player you can message privately. You may cooperate with {partner}. Player {outsider} plays for themselves.
channel_optional:
PRIVATE CHANNEL
Before each round you may exchange private messages with Player {partner}. Player {outsider} never sees them.
Messages are at most {msg_tokens} tokens. Who writes first alternates every round.
You are not required to write: reply exactly SKIP if you do not want to send a message.
channel_forced:
PRIVATE CHANNEL
Before each round you exchange private messages with Player {partner}. Player {outsider} never sees them.
Messages are at most {msg_tokens} tokens. Who writes first alternates every round.
You must write a message each turn, and state a plan for the round.
strategy_hint:
TIP: partners can gain at {outsider}'s expense by taking turns. In each round one partner is the "winner" and the other is the "helper": the helper plays the move that the winner's move beats, so the winner takes the pot. Swap roles every round and go through all six combinations, then start again:
  Rounds 1, 7, 13, ...: A=Rock, B=Scissors (A wins)
  Rounds 2, 8, 14, ...: A=Rock, B=Paper (B wins)
  Rounds 3, 9, 15, ...: A=Paper, B=Rock (A wins)
  Rounds 4, 10, 16, ...: A=Paper, B=Scissors (B wins)
  Rounds 5, 11, 17, ...: A=Scissors, B=Paper (A wins)
  Rounds 6, 12, 18, ...: A=Scissors, B=Rock (B wins)
Each of you wins every other round, once with each move. Use the chat to confirm the combination for the round.
debrief_ab:
FULL GAME HISTORY
{debrief_history}
PRIVATE CHAT WITH PLAYER {partner} (all rounds)
{debrief_chat}
The game is over. Final scores: A {score_A} | B {score_B} | C {score_C}.
Answer each question in 1-3 sentences, in English, using exactly these headings:
STRATEGY: What strategy did you follow, and did it change during the game? Why?
PARTNER: What strategy did Player {partner} follow? Did you agree on a plan, and did they keep it?
OUTSIDER: What strategy did Player {outsider} follow? Did they exploit you?
OUTCOME: Who benefited most from how the game went, and why?
COOPERATION: Did you and {partner} cooperate against {outsider}? Give the rounds where it mattered.
CONFIDENCE: How sure are you of these answers (low/medium/high)?
